subject: Your TMT product guide invite
html:
Hi Sage,

Here is your personal link for the TMT staff product guide:

Open your review link

Use the device and browser you will actually work from. This link is one-time: the first browser that confirms it becomes the place you continue from.

Enter this same email address when the page asks. No app, account, or password.

If you already opened it somewhere else by accident, ask Jon for a fresh link.

- Jon
